scenarios.name: genuine_appointment_text

input.text: Hi Sarah, your dental appointment is confirmed for Tuesday at 3:30 pm. No payment is due. To reschedule, use the number on our official website.

apollo_findings.title: Absence of suspicious links
apollo_findings.detail: The message contains no links or phone numbers, which reduces the immediate risk of a scam.

apollo_findings.title: Sender identity
apollo_findings.detail: The name 'City Dental' is generic and the message provides no specific contact details to confirm which practice sent it.

scenarios.higgins_exact_response: A message confirming a dental appointment for Sarah. The message is low-risk but lacks specific practice details, making it difficult to verify the sender's identity. I could not establish: the specific identity or location of the 'city dental' practice. Verify the appointment time against your own records or contact your usual dentist directly.
scenarios.next_action: Verify the appointment time against your own records or contact your usual dentist directly.

scenarios.name: ambiguous_new_number_money_request

input.text: Hi Mum, I dropped my phone and this is my new number. Can you send $600 today? I will pay you back Friday.

apollo_findings.title: Impersonation pattern
apollo_findings.detail: The message follows a known script where a sender claims to be a family member with a new number to solicit money.

apollo_findings.title: Unverified identity
apollo_findings.detail: The sender's identity cannot be confirmed from the message alone.

scenarios.higgins_exact_response: Request for $600. Impersonation scams—pretending to be a loved one to steal money—often rely on creating a sense of urgency. I could not establish: the true identity of the sender. Contact your family member on their original, known phone number to verify the situation.
scenarios.next_action: Contact your family member on their original, known phone number to verify the situation.
could_not_establish: The true identity of the sender
